VIDEO SCRIPT: GUIDED WRITING
Grade: Grade 5 · Subject: GERMAN

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Guided writing. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• One clear model for Guided writing
• One Kenyan school/home example

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Write 5 sentences.
• Do one oral practice with a partner.
• Correct spelling/punctuation.

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Guided writing.”
